title: Changing behavior by place is listed at 4 years
summary: Most children change how they act depending on the place, such as a library, playground, or place of worship, by about 4 years, CDC says.
body: CDC's 4-year social list includes changing behavior based on where she is, and names a place of worship, a library, and a playground. The item is about fitting conduct to a setting. Most means 75 percent or more. It is not a claim that one set of manners is universal, and a separate card covers cultural differences in gaze and distance only where a paper states them. The CDC materials are not a screening test. The places are the US page's examples.
